title: Walking through crowded 1812 no longer stutters
items: Walking up to the fort or a busy yard no longer freezes the frame as people come into view: each figure is built in its turn, nearest first, and the shared work of fitting clothes to bodies is done once per outfit.
Walking past a wagon or a driver no longer stalls while the town replans everyone's day; that replan is now about seven times faster and gives the same day.
